summary: SERTEX mobile FAZ B1 wave 1 (rich task card + search highlight) verified end-to-end via Expo web preview (390x844) as serkan/19071987. All 6 acceptance items pass: rich task cards render with accent bar / status pill / due date coloring (overdue shows red 25.02.2026 10:00 with alert icon on 'Bineği al') / subtask progress bar (X/Y) / reminder bell / assignee avatars where applicable; typing 'resim' filters to 1 result and highlights the matched substring with cyan background (rgba(0,240,255,0.18)); toggle to done->pending round-trips and updates the accent/strikethrough; task detail shows Bitiş, Alt Görevler, and Hatırlatma sections with reminder chips (Kapalı/1/3/7/14 gün) which set and disable correctly; create-via-FAB adds the task to the list. No blocking bugs.

action_items: OPTIONAL: chase down the deprecated `pointerEvents` prop coming from a library (react-native-web internals) — same warning tracked across iter108/109/110.
critical_code_review_comments: TaskRow.tsx renderTitle() correctly does case-insensitive substring match without regex — safe against special chars in search input.
TaskRow.tsx: subtask progress bar renders width as `${(counts.done / counts.total) * 100}%` — division-by-zero guarded because subtaskCounts() returns null when total is 0. Good.
TaskRow.tsx: `hasReminder` uses `reminder_days != null` (loose) — intentionally treats 0 as 'has reminder'; matches types.ts semantics.
TaskRow.tsx: assignee list falls back to task.assignee_name when task.assignees is empty. Consistent with backend legacy field.
